title: Batch with invalid message — only it fails
description: Two messages arrive for the clientes queue. The first is valid; the second has an invalid GUID. The Lambda must process them in the same batch, succeed for the first, and report only the second as a BatchItemFailure. The valid client record must appear in DynamoDB. The invalid message is retried by SQS and eventually reaches the DLQ.

expect.outcome: partial — first message succeeds, second fails and is retried by SQS

dlq.note: The invalid message appears here after 3 delivery attempts (~6-9 minutes with the default visibility timeout).
